# Tweak My Client 3.1 is out
**Important: Support for Minecraft 1.19.1, which means Minecraft 1.19 is no longer supported and the mod will not work on Minecraft 1.19!**
## Features
- New feature `crystalBeamsDisableMode`. (#14)
- New feature `disableCrystalBeams`. (#14)
## Fixes
- Fix `disableSlowdown` make you slower when swimming. (#11)
- Fix `featureAutoClimb` not working properly. (#10)
- Fix crash with `featureAutoReconnect`. (#15)
- Fix mod cannot be separated for loading. (#13)
## Patches
- Add `disableSlowdown` support for berries. (#12)
- Disable `chunkEdgeLagFix` when `Forget Me Chunk` is installed.
